description: This file defines the CassandraGatewayListProvider class, which implements IGatewayListProvider to manage and provide gateway addresses in a Cassandra-based Orleans clustering setup. It includes initialization, caching, and retrieval logic for gateway URIs.

classes.name: CassandraGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider for managing gateway address discovery in a Cassandra-backed Orleans cluster. Handles initialization, caching, and retrieval of gateway URIs.

methods.name: CassandraGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration options and dependencies for the provider.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the session and queries for Cassandra communication and ensures required tables exist.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of gateway URIs, employing caching to optimize repeated calls.
